check: pnpm generate:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm dogfood:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm build:packages && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm size && pnpm bible:check
check:full: pnpm check && node tooling/size/check.mjs --release && pnpm storybook:build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm perf:smoke && pnpm consumer:check
test: pnpm -r --if-present test --reporter=default --reporter=../../tooling/terminal/vitest-reporter.mjs && pnpm size:test && pnpm icons:test && pnpm docs:test && pnpm trust:test && pnpm dogfood:test && pnpm safety:test && pnpm feature:test
size:changed: pnpm build:packages && node tooling/size/check.mjs --changed && pnpm icons:size
size:release: pnpm build:packages && node tooling/size/check.mjs --release && pnpm icons:size
build:packages: pnpm --filter @flux-ui/tokens build && pnpm --filter @flux-ui/icons build && pnpm --filter @flux-ui/identity build && pnpm --filter @flux-ui/react build
generate:check: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-brand.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-components.mjs --check
consumer:check: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @flux-ui/docs exec tsc -p consumer/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @flux-ui/docs exec playwright test --config consumer/playwright.config.ts
